title: Two decades of service: Kiranjyothi turns 20
summary: On 26 July 2024 the Foundation completed 20 years of service to students, farmers and elders.
body:
Since 26 July 2004 the Kiranjyothi Research Foundation has worked quietly for education, skill development and rural welfare.

Twenty years on, the work continues with the same spirit: Live and Let Live.

title: MS Excel Competition for students
summary: A one-hour MS Excel competition at the school campus with cash prizes for the top three.
body:
The Kiranjyothi Skill Development Academy held an MS Excel competition on 26 March 2024 at the school campus. The test lasted 1 hour.

Prizes: 1st Rs. 1,500, 2nd Rs. 1,000 and 3rd Rs. 500.

title: Technical lecture: Cloud, AWS, SQL, DevOps and Python
summary: An employability session where an experienced IT professional oriented youth on cloud, AWS/SQL, DevOps and Python.
body:
On Sunday 26 March 2024 (9:00 am to 4:00 pm) the Skill Development Academy hosted a technical lecture session titled 'An orientation session on Cloud Transformation, AWS/SQL, DevOps and Python'.

The resource person is a software professional with more than 8 years of experience who has trained over 2000 students.

[Owner: add the speaker's full name, attendance and photos.]

title: How to Succeed in Interview and Group Discussion
summary: A Sunday workshop by an expert team from Hyderabad on interviews, group discussion, resumes and personality development.
body:
On 22 October 2023 (Sunday, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm) a renowned expert team from Hyderabad conducted a full-day programme.

Topics: how to do an interview and group discussion effectively, tips for good communication, resume writing and interview preparation, personality development and career guidance.

title: Support and distribution programme for the elderly
summary: Clothes and essentials were distributed to old-aged people of the village.
body:
